description: This file defines a 'Token' class used in expression parsing, representing tokens such as operators, literals, functions, and brackets, with methods for building and identifying token types.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: Represents a token used in parsing mathematical expressions or similar, with types including operators, literals, functions, and brackets.

methods.name: buildLiteral
methods.description: Creates a token of type LITERAL with the given string content.

methods.name: buildOperator
methods.description: Creates a token of type OPERATOR with the given Operator object.

methods.name: buildFunction
methods.description: Creates a token of type FUNCTION with the given Function object.

methods.name: buildOpenToken
methods.description: Creates an open bracket token associated with a BracketPair.

methods.name: buildCloseToken
methods.description: Creates a close bracket token associated with a BracketPair.
